evidence.statement: FY2025 consolidated revenue was KRW 2.351785tn, operating income KRW 0.524188tn and net income KRW 0.388674tn; revenue and operating income increased 36.1% and 52.1% year over year.
H1 2026 revenue was KRW 1.484715tn, operating income KRW 0.353314tn, net income KRW 0.282054tn and operating cash flow KRW 0.268262tn, up 37.2%, 39.1%, 54.1% and 107.6% year over year, respectively.

Q2 2026 revenue was KRW 770.3bn and operating income KRW 176.2bn, up 39.3% and 46.7% year over year. Overseas revenue reached KRW 645.8bn, up 46.7%, and operating margin was approximately 22.9%, the sixth consecutive quarter above 20%.

Q2 2026 sales in the Americas were KRW 203.6bn (+54% YoY), China KRW 181.0bn (+44%) and Europe KRW 80.6bn (+61%), showing broad growth across the three major overseas regions rather than a single-country spike.

H1 2026 noodle/snack sales were KRW 1.344886tn, 90.6% of total sales, while total export product sales were KRW 1.230840tn, 82.9% of total sales. Exact Buldak-brand revenue is not separately disclosed and is not assumed equal to noodle/snack revenue.

Buldak exceeded 10 billion cumulative units and about KRW 7tn cumulative sales by end-May 2026, is sold in about 100 countries, and Samyang Foods accounts for roughly 60% of South Korea's ramyeon exports.

Independent press reported Buldak YouTube search interest on Google Trends reached a record level in late July/early August 2026 while U.S. distribution expanded beyond Walmart into Kroger and Target and European mainstream retail distribution broadened.

The March 2026 KRX Value-Up disclosure targets a 40.2% increase in production volume versus the prior base, cites Miryang Plant 2 completion in 2025 and China plant operation planned for 2027, and states 2022-2025 export CAGR of 41.7% on a separate-company basis.

The KRX Value-Up disclosure shows operating margin rising from 9.9% in 2022 to 22.3% in 2025 and ROE from 17.6% to 31.0%, supporting evidence that recent capex and overseas expansion coincided with materially better economics.
Using the harness TTM bridge FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025 gives revenue KRW 2.754409tn, operating income KRW 0.623426tn, net income KRW 0.487694tn, OCF KRW 0.448349tn and PPE purchases KRW 0.227388tn.
evidence.method: FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025 for each line item

evidence.statement: TTM OCF minus PPE purchases is approximately KRW 220.961bn, an 8.0% margin on TTM revenue. This is a mechanical diagnostic, not normalized owner FCF, because growth versus maintenance capex and headquarters/capacity spending are not separated.

At June 30, 2026 accounts receivable was KRW 256.385bn, up 38.4% from 2025 year-end, while inventory was KRW 277.639bn, up 13.3%; H1 working-capital cash effects included KRW 64.574bn use from receivables and KRW 35.804bn use from inventory.

At June 30, 2026 cash plus short-term financial assets was approximately KRW 749.312bn versus borrowings excluding leases of approximately KRW 601.830bn, leaving net cash of about KRW 147.482bn before lease liabilities. Credit ratings were AA-/Stable.
Issued shares were 7,533,015 at June 30, 2026 and were unchanged from 2025 year-end; observable growth is not being funded through persistent share dilution.

FY2025 consolidated audit opinion and internal accounting control opinion were unqualified with no material weakness reported. The 2026 auditor change to EY/HanYoung followed expiry of the designated-auditor engagement and audit-committee selection, not a disclosed accounting dispute.

The filing records a KRW 227bn headquarters property acquisition and KRW 155.417bn of ongoing equipment projects. These uses do not establish value destruction, but the headquarters purchase raises the hurdle for management/capital-allocation scoring because its incremental owner return is not yet demonstrated.

Samyang RoundSquare and related parties held 44.98% as of July 6, 2026. Shares subject to major contracts/pledges totaled 412,005, or 5.47% of issued shares, down from 8.09% previously. This is a governance/liquidity monitor rather than evidence of operating impairment.
Samyang Foods closed at KRW 1,264,000 on September 10, 2026. Applied to 7,533,015 issued shares, the synchronized market capitalization is approximately KRW 9.522tn.
